name: Assassin
startingFeatName: How I Could Just Kill a Man
startingFeatDescription: If a enemy drops to 0 HP they are instantly dead, no unconscious stage
description: An assassin could have a rifle, could have a sword, might be a ninja, or might be a sniper.

name: Brawler
startingFeatDescription: Any unarmed attack to an opponent's head deals LVL extra damage. At 2nd level it deals 2*LVL damage.
description: Anyone who fights using their hands, they could be a street fighter, or a martial artist, or anyone who like to hit people.

name: Deadbang
startingFeatDescription: Allows you to fix a gun that is broken, and add to / upgrade weapons with components
description: Trained in the use of firearms from close range. They could use a shotgun, blunderbuss, or a pistol, but if they get close to their target, that target is dead.

name: Hunter
startingFeatDescription: Allows you to fix a gun that is broken, and add to / upgrade weapons with components
description: Hunters are trained in the use of firearms from afar.

name: Knight
startingFeatDescription: You are able to hits so hard that you substitute accuracy for strength; take a -1 on your attack roll, but add LVL to your damage roll. At 2nd level, take a -2 for a +LVL*2 bonus to damage.
description: A Knight is anyone who favors the use of melee weapons. He could literally be a full plate armor "Knight," or just a big dude with a rusty lead pipe.

name: Priest
startingFeatDescription: You point at an opponent and they are hit by otherworldly energy from your god, unerringly, for LVL worth of DMG. Your opponent does get a Dodge save for 1/2 DMG.
description: A magic user whose magic is bestowed by their god.

name: Thief
startingFeatDescription: When you attempt to lockpick, you can reroll a failed attempt. And 2nd level, adds +1 to your roll(s) as well as allowing a re-roll if necessary. Can't be taken twice in a row.
description: Thieves tend to keep to the darkness and take what they want; quietly if possible but through force if necessary.

name: Warlock
startingFeatDescription: A Warlock's power comes from their bloodline, and this makes all of their spells Simple.
description: A magician with innate, inherited abilities, who is the most ready to fight of the magicians. Can use more weapons than Priest or Wizard.

name: Wizard
startingFeatDescription: Once per day, when casting a spell, the Wizard may treat their caster level as +1 for the effects of that spell.
description: A magician that has learned magic from study.
